monthClosing.title: Month closing
monthClosing.asClosed: Historical state as closed. Later payments and transfers do not change this version.
monthClosing.endBalanceCents: Observed balance on the final day

monthClosing.pending: Historical facts changed. The accepted report remains unchanged until you review and confirm a new version.
monthClosing.unelected: Not included in the unpaid reserve
monthClosing.consent: I reviewed all report sections, the unknown values and the exact changes, and confirm this version.

monthClosing.noChange: There is no report change to confirm. The accepted version and pending state were retained.
monthClosing.saved: Report version saved. Current cash and earmarks were not changed.

completeness.END_DATE_OBSERVED: A real check exists on the final day; this does not establish complete bank activity.
completeness.INCOMPLETE: Final-day bank balance is unknown. The amounts shown are the last confirmed historical state.
completeness.NO_OBSERVATION: No bank observation exists through this month end. Bank balance, allocation and free amount are unknown.

monthClosing.unknownOutcome: The confirmation result is unknown. Check the original request or explicitly retry it with the same key. Do not create a new confirmation.
monthClosing.evidenceExplanation: Review every page of sources and evidence. Amounts can stay the same even when the historical basis changes.
monthClosing.initialReportExplanation: You are saving the first historical report for this month. Unknown amounts stay unknown. Closing does not debit or transfer money.
monthClosing.reviewSourcesEmpty: There is no additional historical evidence. The known data and unknown amounts shown above will be saved.
monthClosing.reviewSameAmounts: Amounts are unchanged. Review the dates, sources, ordering and historical evidence changes below.
monthClosing.initialSourcesExplanation: These are the historical sources for the first report. Review every page before confirming.

budgetUpdate.futureConsent: I confirm the listed changes to future months' money
budgetUpdate.unchangedFundingConsent: Only the money allocation changes; obligation and savings funding stays unchanged
budgetUpdate.vectorConsent: I have checked the complete allocation of the card balance across all months
budgetUpdate.bankConsent: I actually checked the card; the entered balance already includes the payments
budgetUpdate.unchangedConsent: I confirm the balance is current even when it matches the previous amount

budgetUpdate.oldData: The estimate uses an earlier actual card check.
budgetUpdate.reminder: Please check the card balance again.

budgetUpdate.savedReadFailed: Saving is confirmed, but the result could not be loaded yet.
budgetUpdate.unknown: The save outcome is still unknown. Check it or retry the original request with the same key.
budgetUpdate.reloadBase: Load current base and retain inputs for a new review
budgetUpdate.unsaved: There are unsaved changes. Leave and lose this draft?

errors.compound: The same item cannot be changed and have its funding transferred in one update. Your draft is retained; nothing is partially saved.
errors.payment: Check the payment amount, actual balance and required confirmations. Payment outside the card requires a confirmed unchanged balance and an explanation.
errors.policy: Carrying several past source months together is not supported yet. Only you can choose another action.
errors.access: Access could not be verified. Sign in again and check the outcome before saving again.
errors.conflict: Confirmed data, ordering or the month has changed. Your input is retained: load the current base and review again.
errors.storage: The operation could not be completed. Your input is retained; retry the original request or read the outcome.
errors.input: Check amounts, dates, actions and confirmations. Monthly amounts must be nonnegative and sum exactly to the card balance.
